premises.text: Data breaches are a widespread issue affecting many companies
premises.evidence_span: more than 150 million records were breached by Equifax. And these are records of people like you and me. More than 60% of companies have already been breached.

premises.text: Encryption is the most effective method for mitigating data breach risks
premises.evidence_span: Encryption is the most effective measuring in mitigating this risk.

premises.text: Calypso is a cloud database solution that keeps data encrypted at all times
premises.evidence_span: Calypso is the first never decrypt cloud database solution.

premises.text: Users can search through encrypted data without decrypting it
premises.evidence_span: While encrypted, one is able to search through the data, fetch them back to the application in a private way, and only there the data gets decrypted.

premises.text: Calypso can conceal data against database attacks
premises.evidence_span: Calypso actually conceals the data against any database attack.

premises.text: Calypso allows SQL queries to be run on encrypted data
premises.evidence_span: on top of this encrypted data, and while they are encrypted, someone can run SQL queries.

premises.text: Combining cryptography with differential privacy ensures secure indexing of records
premises.evidence_span: we combine cryptography, so oblivious RAM, with differential privacy, in order to ensure an efficient and secure indexing of these records.

premises.text: Existing solutions either compromise usability or security
premises.evidence_span: solutions like Oracle's transparent encryption offer very high level of usability, but reveal too much information.

premises.text: Calypso offers true security with higher speeds compared to existing solutions
premises.evidence_span: Calypso is the first one to offer this true security with orders of magnitude higher speeds.

premises.text: The market for secure database solutions is projected to grow significantly
premises.evidence_span: This is a global market that's projected to reach $1.6 billion by 2022.
